name: academic_long
description: Fifteen years and twenty publications. Far more content than two pages hold, and the section that would swamp a page if diversity decay did not exist.
headline: Associate Professor of Computational Biology

atoms.text: Lead a group of eleven on structural prediction of membrane proteins
Principal investigator on two NWO grants totalling 2.4 million euro
Teach the graduate course on statistical learning for the life sciences
Established the lab's pipeline for cryo-EM density interpretation
Supervised six PhD candidates to completion
Developed a coarse-grained model of lipid–protein interaction still in use by the group
